subject.title: marketplace-crons: Fnac devuelve 500 en pedidos y batch

question: Should Fnac `/offers_update` withdraw failures get an intra-cron retry/backoff, or should retries stay limited to auth/read/batch-status calls until Fnac idempotency is proven?
rationale: The live recurrence is now centered on `deleteFnacOffer`, but prior triage explicitly warned that retrying side-effecting Fnac POSTs may duplicate batches or actions.

options.title: Keep retries to safe endpoints first
options.body: Add bounded retry/backoff for `auth`, `orders_query`, and `batch_status`, while leaving `offers_update` and `orders_update` on next-tick recovery until idempotency is proven.

options.title: Add guarded withdraw retry
options.body: Retry `deleteFnacOffer` only with contract evidence or code-level guards that prevent duplicate batch side effects.

options.title: Accept next-tick recovery
options.body: Keep current behavior and treat these provider 500s as operational noise unless BigQuery shows sustained delayed withdrawals or customer impact.

recommendation.title: Keep retries to safe endpoints first
recommendation.body: Add bounded retry/backoff for `auth`, `orders_query`, and `batch_status`, while leaving `offers_update` and `orders_update` on next-tick recovery until idempotency is proven.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Fnac/marketplace area history and triage labels make this the best available routing candidate for the retry-boundary decision.
